description: Update cvrt-fields settings. github_token is write-only and stored encrypted; a blank or omitted token keeps the stored one. clear_github_token: true deletes it. compat_acf_functions switches the opt-in ACF compatibility layer. shortcode_options_pages lists the options pages whose values shortcodes may print. Returns the settings as fields_get_settings does (token as { set }, compat_acf_functions as a boolean, shortcode_options_pages as a list). compat_acf_functions and shortcode_options_pages need cvrt-fields 0.4.0+: the tool checks fields_status features first and refuses (nothing sent) on an older version, which would ignore them and answer 200.

clear_github_token.description: true deletes the stored token (wins over github_token)

compat_acf_functions.description: Opt-in ACF compatibility layer (default false): get_field(), the_field(), get_fields(), update_field() and [acf] exist while ACF is not loaded; never active when ACF is loaded. false switches it off; omitted keeps the setting

github_token.description: GitHub token for plugin updates; write-only, stored encrypted, blank keeps the stored one

shortcode_options_pages.description: Definition keys (e.g. ui_options_page_site, see fields_list_definitions options-pages; not menu slugs) of the options pages marked "Available in shortcodes": only their fields are printed by [cvrt_field post_id="option"] / [acf post_id="option"] (default none). Replaces the whole list; [] switches every page off; omitted keeps it. A key of no registered options page is refused (400 cvrt_fields_unknown_options_page naming it, nothing saved). Only pages whose values may be public (any post author can place a shortcode)

name: fields_update_settings
